analytical_question: Which adoption action is justified now?
general_et_finding: Technology-general: generative AI can produce drafts but may produce inaccuracies; maturity and diffusion evidence require independent validation.
application_finding: Application-specific: human-reviewed drafting is relatively reversible; relative advantage versus templates remains unmeasured.
organization_specific_finding: Organization-specific decisive factor: conservative posture, no approved sandbox or evaluation owner.

evidence.claim: The organization and use case are stipulated synthetic test inputs.

contrary_evidence_or_limitations: No measured cost, diffusion, reliability or peer adoption evidence.
Alternatives include manual workflows and templates.
confidence_and_uncertainty: Provisional; external evidence and internal metrics missing.
value_opportunity_implication: Measure relative advantage and cost against existing manual or template workflows before rollout.
risk_governance_implication: Match controls to failure consequences, reversibility, and organization posture.
recommendation_management_implication: Primary recommendation: Defer. Same technology and drafting application, but conservative risk posture and absent approved sandbox/evaluation owner prevent a safe test. Owner: accountable business lead with governance review. Milestone: next-quarter reassessment; establish measurable acceptance criteria before any authorized test.
change_monitoring_triggers: New validation evidence or improved maturity: reconsider when independently demonstrated.
Lower total cost or credible peer adoption: compare against baseline, do not infer benefit from popularity.
Regulatory clarification: reassess on official guidance.
Internal capability or risk-posture change: reassess after documented approval of controls.
Stop or reverse if harms exceed approved thresholds; thresholds require governance agreement.
abstention_or_more_information_needed: Obtain independent benchmarks, regulatory review, baseline cost, and measurable risk thresholds.
